description: Reads one page, collects its links and checks up to 40 of them in page order: working, redirected, broken (4xx/5xx), refused by the target site (401, 403, 429, 999) or no answer. Flags internal links that go through a redirect. Counts against the free daily limit unless cached.

url.description: The page whose links to check, for example store.com/blogs/news

name: check_broken_links
title: Find broken links on a page
